frontier.hypothesis: Variant C (20/222) already holds BOTH the pinned store and cluster A's $s2 seats; the entire remaining gap on that body is that jump2 merges its 0xB edge to three instructions instead of zero. A spelling of that edge that still contributes two C-level arg1 references but collapses to a bare jump into path1's `li v0,0xB` would land at or below 17 with two clusters closed.
frontier.mechanism: Target's 0xB edge is `beqz $s1,.L80028518` into path1's own selection constant, costing nothing; ours must duplicate `store + both calls` to keep nrefs_flow(pseudo 73) in s7's [8,11] window, and jump2's walk-back stops at the `do_calls` label, leaving `li v0,0xB / sh / j do_calls`. The pin itself must stay a SOURCE goto because sched1 precedes jump2 (E-s13-1/2).

Two directions, both cheap: (i) re-run tools/ra_solver on THAT body (not the 17-floor body) and ask whether pseudo 73 can be seated by the livelen axis instead of nrefs - s5 measured a 6-10 insn liveness flip window for pseudo 143 and that sweep was never run against a body that already carries the pin; if livelen suffices, the 0xB edge can revert to a zero-cost `goto set_0xB` (variant A) and the function closes. (ii) enumerate byte-neutral third sites for the two arg1 references - the `==` block's existing call pair and the `>` block's 0x26/0x2D pair are the only other call sites; test giving one of them an arm-style duplicated edge that jump2 fully re-merges. Score every form with two sandbox runs then dif.sh (see the staleness note).

frontier.hypothesis: Cluster B (the `nop` vs `li v0,1` delay-slot fill at emitted slots 45/47 and 126) and s10's insn-344 reorg residual are ONE mark_target_live_regs / opposite_needed decision, and it is the single instruction by which our 216 exceeds target's 215.
frontier.mechanism: Target fills the dispatch chain's `beqz $v0,.L800285DC` delay slot with the `li $v0,0x1` that belongs to the fall-through `D_800A38A8 = 1` block, speculating a value into a register the branch has just read; ours refuses and emits a nop plus a later `li v0,1`. s10 proved this does not move under any of the sixteen exit-form assignments, so it has no measured C-level dial.
frontier.next_probe: Locate the dispatch chain's final `beq` insn UID in tmp/grind/func_800283D0/s10/iso_dumps/iso.dbr, grep that UID in tmp/grind/func_800283D0/s10/iso_dumps/dbr.log for its thr/simp lines, and check whether the steal is granted there for the same reason it is refused at insn 344. If both are opposite_needed decisions, clusters B and the frontier-1 nop collapse into one residual with one mechanism, and s10's open sub-question (why $v0 is in opposite_needed at insn 686 despite the REG_DEAD flush at label 347) becomes the highest-value probe left.
